summary: Silas secures the structural dampers as the magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea stresses the primary induction loops. He wipes oxidized rust from his gauntlet before passing the heavy brass baton to Hector, noting the erratic magnetic pull on the metal.
narrative_prose: The magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea rattles the teeth within The First Forge, filling the dim amber sanctum with the sharp scent of ozone. Silas must DEFEND the fragile superconductor array by trying to ATTRACT the chaotic flux into a stable grounding sink, using a lead baffle to CONCEAL the exposed wiring from stray arcs. Wiping oxidized copper from his gauntlet, he forcefully presses the heavy runic brass baton directly into Hector's hand to complete the physical handoff.

A fine layer of oxidized rust dust coats the copper workbenches, glowing faintly in the dim amber light.
